description: This file is a BitBake recipe fragment (.inc file) used for building and configuring glibc locale data within the OpenEmbedded build system. It contains definitions for dependencies, package configurations, locale file handling, and build instructions specific to glibc locales.
external_files: Various locale source files and directories specified in LOCALETREESRC

methods.name: copy_locale_files
methods.description: Copies locale files from the source directory to the destination directory with specified permissions.

methods.name: do_install
methods.description: Installs locale files by calling copy_locale_files for various directories, and handles special cases such as removing empty directories when gconv is not required.
